name: Pet Sim
description: Hatch it, care for it, train it, show it off. This is the pack the library grew up around -- the pet compounds predate the genre map -- and it is the reference for what 'done' looks like: every component here has a compound it participates in and an event another component actually consumes. Care is a meter game and training is a skill game, and keeping them separate is the point: a pet that improves purely by being fed teaches nothing, and one that improves purely by minigame is a minigame with a mascot. Breeding closes the loop by making the next generation depend on how the last one was raised.

signatureCompound.name: Raised Well Enough to Win
signatureCompound.description: The care loop paying off in public: pet_needs_panel keeps feeding, cleanliness and play from decaying, pet_training_minigame converts attention into stats, pet_show_judge scores those stats against a rubric the player can read beforehand, and breed_genealogy passes what was earned to the next generation. A pet that wins is a pet that was raised, and the components make that traceable.
